name: lonlat-mainnet-security-team
description: Mainnet launch security team coordinating audit, adversarial Foundry tests and multisig ops for sign-off gates.

displayDescription.en: Coordinates pre-mainnet audit, adversarial tests and multisig drills into a sign-off launch gate package.
displayDescription.zh: 主理统筹合约上线前审计、攻击路径测试与多签权限演练，输出可签字的上线门禁包与残留风险。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我们准备主网上线，请专家团按审计-测试-多签三线给出可签字的上线门禁包
defaultInitPrompt.en: We are launching on mainnet; please deliver a sign-off launch gate package across audit, testing and multisig lines

quickPrompts.zh: 我们准备主网上线，请专家团按审计-测试-多签三线给出可签字的上线门禁包
quickPrompts.en: We are launching on mainnet; please deliver a sign-off launch gate package across audit, testing and multisig lines

quickPrompts.zh: 审计发现High项未修完，请专家团评估能否带风险灰度上线并写残留风险签字页
quickPrompts.en: High findings are not fully fixed; assess whether a risk-accepted canary launch is acceptable and draft a residual-risk sign-off page

quickPrompts.zh: 请把升级权、暂停权、提款权拆到多签，并配Foundry负面测试与监控项
quickPrompts.en: Split upgrade, pause and withdraw keys into multisig, with Foundry negative tests and monitoring items
